p0_target: replace the external M230 empty/fixed-latency actions with one executable descriptor-to-commit lifecycle
executable_lifecycle: atomic empty-tile header/done bypass with no storage side effect
tagged INT8 weight request and response
tagged Acc19 read response and signed add/sub or dense-zero update
eight tagged commit reads and backpressured commit beats
normal done or sticky fail-closed abort

modes_on_identical_ports.dense: one descriptor for every source/context pair; zero factors still consume factor, weight and Acc ports
modes_on_identical_ports.bit_sparse: one one-hot descriptor for every nonzero source/context occurrence
modes_on_identical_ports.context_factorized: one source descriptor carries an exact nonzero context/sign mask and reuses one weight response across its contexts

required: factor, weight, Acc-read, Acc-write, commit and abort backpressure

trace_mapping.population: M230 raw-mode 100 records / ten exact-binary FC1 modules / ten samples
trace_mapping.output_lane_policy: each frozen 96-output-channel block is serialized as twelve eight-lane slices
trace_mapping.response_policy: clean fixed latency and no backpressure; directed VCS separately proves stalls
trace_mapping.purpose: module-level lifecycle cycle comparison on identical ports

prohibited_claims: physical SRAM timing or macro PPA
